1818-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Repeat from step 2.

789-4210-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-4210-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-1854-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-8095.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

262-971-4687.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
262-971-4687.description:
Activate Elemental Mastery by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

431-4365-6441-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-4365-6441-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

567-4399-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
567-4399-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

129-1409-4460-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2440-5434-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-5434-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

997-2525-3763-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
997-2525-3763-6749.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6096-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6096-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6096-7296.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

1308-4017-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-4017-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

1810-1846-3191-4276.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands
1810-1846-3191-4276.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return High Tide and Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate at least three Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
High Tide triggers twice for each Island tapped this way, adding that much {U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Turnabout and Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 6.

2921-3564-4275-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
2921-3564-4275-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-3564-4275-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

2557-3484-5391-6774.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
2557-3484-5391-6774.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

826-2034-2178-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5226-5231.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5226-5231.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-5226-5231.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

892-2743-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
892-2743-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
892-2743-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Sublime Epiphany at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Sublime Epiphany spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

1414-4053-4740-6613.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4 if you've cast two or more spells this turn, 5 if you've cast one spell this turn, or 7 otherwise.
1414-4053-4740-6613.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0} and 3 life. It will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Lotus Petal, and it will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

864-4002-4067-6281.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
864-4002-4067-6281.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Eternal Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Eternal Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

2034-4484-4871-5632.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2034-4484-4871-5632.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1414-2051-2350-4970-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two land cards in your hand.
1414-2051-2350-4970-5751.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {G}, returning at least two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

500-3129-3858-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting 32 +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

914-1550-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
914-1550-3750.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Sword of Hearth and Home.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Dockside Extortionist, search your library for a basic land card, and put both cards onto the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1283-1580-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {2}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1309-2104-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
1309-2104-3742.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets that is tapped and attacking.
Salvager of Secrets enters, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

2856-3554-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Mystical Tutor and Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Cast Mystical Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Seasons Past from your library.
Repeat.
